title: Scaling Down Semantic Leakage: Investigating Associative Bias in Smaller Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating a 'Mean Leak-Rate' by comparing the semantic similarity (using BERT-score and SentenceBERT) between language model generations and a leakage-triggering concept (such as a color, color-related name, or set expression) against a control generation prompted without the triggering concept.
